The repository checker verifies each generator by exact symbolic polynomial substitution; the independent closure alone does not verify those substitutions. A projective stabilizer injects into Aut of the smooth minimal Enriques model; published orders 8 and 24 provide matching upper bounds. Thus full stabilizer and all-automorphism realization follow, assuming the displayed published Enriques models.
